entities.summary: Anjelica Castillo, previously known for 22 years as Baby Hope, was a four-year-old Mexican-American girl from New York City who was murdered in 1991. Her body was not identified until 2013. The case received national attention due to the young age of the victim and the manner of her death. After her identification, Castillo's paternal cousin, Conrado Juarez confessed to murdering the girl. Juarez died in custody on November 18, 2018, after changing his plea to "not guilty," claiming the confession was coerced.
